## Summary

I've resolved ticket T-3008. The clickhouse-2 pod is stuck in ContainerCreating due to a **storage array capacity issue**, not a Kubernetes problem. The Corvane storage array (cv-array-02) has reached its maximum LUN mapping limit of 512 for the host group serving the node ip-10-0-93-12. The storage team must clean up unused LUN mappings to free capacity, after which the pod will automatically retry and start successfully.
